hints.title: Playlist Length and Distinct Songs States
hints.text: Define states by playlist length i and number of unique songs j used so far.

hints.title: Two Mutually Exclusive Transitions
hints.text: Adding a new song gives (n - (j - 1)) choices. Replaying an already used song requires j > k and gives (j - k) choices.

hints.title: Recurrence Equation and Modulo
hints.text: dp[i][j] equals dp[i-1][j-1] * (n - j + 1) + dp[i-1][j] * max(0, j - k) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numMusicPlaylists(self, n: int, goal: int, k: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for i in range(1, goal + 1):
            nxt = [0] * (n + 1)
            for j in range(1, min(i, n) + 1):
                new_song = dp[j - 1] * (n - j + 1)
                old_song = dp[j] * max(0, j - k)
                nxt[j] = (new_song + old_song) % MOD
            dp = nxt
        return dp[n]
```

complexity.notes: 1D space rolling transitions evaluating unique song combinations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all N^goal playlists causes exponential timeouts.
